### How to Actually Love God with All Your Heart, Soul, Mind and Strength
Author: Kelly Balarie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/how-to-actually-love-god-with-your-all-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Mark 12:30
Points:
- Divided attention weakens relationships, and offering God only partial focus drains real heart devotion.
- Loving God with the heart means submitting personal emotions and thoughts to the authority of Scripture.
- Loving Him with the soul involves aligning personal affections and dislikes with what God loves and rejects.
- Loving God with the mind requires fixing one's thoughts and imagination on heavenly, pure, and praiseworthy things.
- Loving Him with all strength means persevering through faith and prayer with every fiber of one's being.

### Love God With Your Mind
Author: Dan Johnson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/love-god-with-your-mind-homeword-october-30.html
Passage: Matthew 22:37
Points:
- Christians often focus on emotional needs or loving neighbors while neglecting the command to love God intellectually.
- Faith must stand on objective, historical truth rather than superficial statements or purely experiential feelings.
- Disregarding the life of the mind creates fragile beliefs that collapse during hardship and fuels cultural secularism.
- Loving God with the mind includes intentional study, theological discernment, and guarding against biblical inaccuracies.
- Understanding and cherishing God's truth with our minds must come first before we can guide others to it.
